title: Concurrency research
description: Synthetic multi-source evidence with paraphrases and a disputed claim.

units.text: A mutex protects a critical section. Only one thread can hold a mutex at a time.
Busy waiting repeatedly polls a condition and consumes processor time.
Mutual exclusion stops simultaneous updates to shared data. A blocking wait suspends the waiting thread.
Claim for discussion: busy waiting consumes no processor time. Compare this claim with the textbook before accepting it.
